label: BridgeDb cross-references per database
description: Count how many wp:Metabolite nodes carry a BridgeDb-materialised cross-reference to each external chemical database. Shows the reach of the BridgeDb metabolite mapping in PlantMetWiki (release v3.2): e.g. Wikidata, PubChem and ChEBI each reach ~3,000 metabolites, up from a handful of source identifiers.
